page.overview:
Who is Sadala Army?

The Sadala Army is the Saiyan military force in Universe 6. It is the mightiest army in that entire universe. The Sadala Defense Forces is a sub-group of the army made up of Saiyans in charge of protecting Planet Sadala from foreign invaders in Universe 6.

Renso is the retired captain of the Defense Forces and Cabba is part of the group, considered the ace of their Elite members. They are in service of the King Sadala. The army avoids Caulifla and her territory, as they are unable to defeat her and her henchmen, though in the manga her gang is shown to be a group of noble thieves, after robbing shipment of food & jewelry meant for King Sadala, the gang members are shown giving the food to poor Saiyan children (it is unclear if the Sadala Army is aware of this fact, as it could give them another reason to avoid conflict with Caulifla's Gang).

When Team Universe 6 lost in the Tournament of Power, the Sadala Army were erased with the rest of Universe 6. They were later revived when the erased universes were restored.
